common_cons: Wooting 80HE: wired-only, premium price, and a rattling spacebar (PCWorld)
SteelSeries Apex Pro Gen 3 TKL: no hot-swap switches and a premium price for a partly plastic build (Laptop Mag, PCWorld)
Razer Huntsman V3 Pro TKL: loud, mediocre typing sound despite elite gaming performance (ProSettings)
Logitech G Pro X TKL Lightspeed: no hot-swap and a price that is hard to justify against HE rivals (Custom PC, Eurogamer)
common_pros: Wooting 80HE: best-in-class software and rapid trigger tuning (PCWorld, TechPowerUp)
SteelSeries Apex Pro Gen 3 TKL: OmniPoint 3.0 adjustable switches, OLED smart display, and Rapid Tap + Protection Mode (Laptop Mag, PCWorld)
Razer Huntsman V3 Pro TKL: analog optical Gen-2 switches with rapid trigger and on-board adjustment without Synapse (ProSettings)
Logitech G Pro X TKL Lightspeed: Lightspeed wireless indistinguishable from wired, with a tournament carry case (Eurogamer, Custom PC)
